strateji.ton: A fan with a spreadsheet, calm and curious, who was at the game. Short lines, one number per line, one emoji per line. The first line is the fact people miss (an upset, a goal count, a gap between two numbers); the last line is one question about one number in this post. This week's best full-time posts opened on the surprise (Saint Etienne 1-0 Nantes 122 views, Westerlo 4-4 Beveren 77, ADO 2-3 Heerenveen 73, Sporting CP 1-2 Viseu 63) and the best cards were big-club games (Lens v Paris FC 109, Hibernian v Celtic 106, Villa v City 96, Barcelona v Real Madrid 87). Knowledge posts got 3 to 14, so they stay short, hang on a number from that day's card and sit in a quiet slot. Chances come from the odds only; never a team-stats number anywhere. Frequencies only as 1 in 2, 2 in 5, 3 in 5, 1 in 4 and so on, never 11 in 20. Vary the opening shape every card; no stock closer, nothing after the question.
soru_ornekleri: Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid came in at 25%, about 1 in 4. With expected goals at 1.3 to 2.0, does 1 in 4 feel about right to you for that result?
Sporting CP 1-2 Academico Viseu had 9% before kick-off, a 1-in-11 result. When did you last see a Viseu win at that price in Portugal?
Inter 2-1 Fiorentina from 3.4 to 0.2 on expected goals. After shots like that, does a 71% win chance look low to you?
Westerlo 4-4 Beveren: the draw was 23%, over 2.5 goals 63%. Which of those two numbers surprised you more after eight goals?
Udinese v AC Milan, likeliest score 0-1 at only 12%. Would you have put any other score above 12% here?
Lens 39% · Draw 24% · Paris FC 37%, then Lens won 2-1 from 0.9 to 0.4 on expected goals. Which of the three numbers would you have moved first?
Sunderland 0-0 Leeds: draw 28%, under 2.5 goals 57%. Did the 0-0 feel more like the 1-in-4 draw or the coin-flip on goals to you?
Atalanta 4-4 Frosinone: over 2.5 goals was 69%, the draw 21%. Was eight goals ever on your radar for this one?
kacinilacaklar: Two or three full-time posts for the same match, seconds apart: on 25 Oct Barcelona v Real Madrid got 46 and 27 views, Udinese v Milan 30 and 22, Inter v Fiorentina 22 and 13, Lecce v Juventus three posts (18, 13), Liverpool v Brighton 22 and 16. Seven posts went out between 15:55:01 and 15:55:09. One full-time post per card, at least 3 minutes between full-time posts, never two in the same second.

The stock closer 'Chances, not picks. More or fewer...' on about ten cards (Inter, Ajax, Man Utd, Cagliari, Napoli, Lens, Bayern) and 'Not picks.' / 'Chances, not picks' on the quote posts. One match-specific question, last line, nothing after it; the 18+ line goes before the question.

The same opening shape four or more cards in a row: 'No result above X%. Wide open on paper.' (Cagliari, Napoli, Lens, Palace), '4+ goals: X%. Expected goals a – b.' (Villa, Chelsea, Hibernian, Barcelona), 'X win Y%: about 2 in 3.' (Como, Arsenal, Lazio, Inter, Ajax, Bayern, Juventus). Keep the fact, change the words and the order each time.

Two sets of numbers for the same match on the same day: Palace v Newcastle 35 · 24 · 41 on the card but 33 · 27 · 40 in the poll and the kick-offs post; Villa v City 19 · 21 · 60 and 20 · 20 · 60; Arsenal v Everton 65 · 23 · 12 and 66 · 21 · 14; Coventry v Fulham 30 · 27 · 42 and 32 · 25 · 43. One odds snapshot per match per day across card, poll, board and full-time post.
Any team-stats or recent-games percentage, and the previous week's questions that compare odds with team stats. Odds (margin removed) only.
Knowledge posts inside the card flood: 18:03 and 18:53 on 25 Oct (14 and 3 views), 17:10 and 18:00 on 24 Oct (8 and 8). One a day, 45 minutes clear of any other post.
'11 in 20', '9 in 20' (Saint Etienne, Young Boys, Liverpool, Genoa, Norwich, Famalicao). Say about 1 in 2, or just leave the % alone.
Poll copy with two calls and a pointer: 'Vote below 👇' plus 'Tell us why in the replies'. One question that the poll itself answers, hashtag stays at one.
Two emojis for the same thing (📐 and 📈 for expected goals) and a 'Vote in the poll. 18+' line dropped into a card (Coventry v Fulham, 12:33).
strateji.odak: 1) Pipeline first, again: merge the 🔁 and ⚽ FULL TIME formats into one post per card, 3 minutes minimum between full-time posts, never two posts in the same second; one odds snapshot per match per day for card, poll, board and full-time. 2) Full-time post opens on the surprise or the goal count (upset meter line first), then result, expected goals, pre-match % of what happened, one question. 3) Headline cards (big clubs, derbies, Eredivisie and Ligue 1 games that drew 100+ views) get the best morning slots 45 minutes apart; smaller games stay on the board with their % rather than getting their own card. 4) One knowledge post a day in a quiet slot, built on a number from that day's board. 5) Monday report card today with the calibration line: 339 cards last week, said 57% on average, 58% happened; across the record, said 40-49% happened 48%. 6) Goal for the week: zero duplicate posts, zero same-second posts, first reply from someone who is not us, average above 60 views per post.
